title: DECSET 1001 — Highlight mouse tracking
summary: CSI ? 1001 h enables highlight mouse tracking: the terminal reports button press, release, and highlight (drag) events. CSI ? 1001 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1001 h Mouse tracking; highlight (drag) events.

gotchas: Highlight mode reports button press, release, and drag (motion while pressed).

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1001 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1001 h/l sequences.
